rules.sentence: Definitive diagnosis relies on microbiologic confirmation from biopsy or surgical specimens, although clinical suspicion and imaging often guide early management.
Treatment requires prolonged multidrug anti-tuberculosis chemotherapy, with surgical intervention indicated for neurologic compromise, spinal instability, intractable pain, or severe deformity.
Insidious symptom onset and nonspecific imaging findings frequently delay diagnosis until advanced vertebral destruction, kyphosis, or spinal cord compression develops.
